stories.title: Boeing to cut about 5% of its commercial plane workforce
summary: Company will cut jobs through a mix of layoffs and attrition as it moderates the pace of ramping up jet productionBoeing will cut about 5% of its commercial plane workforce as it moderates the pace of ramping up jet production, the company said on Monday.The company will eliminate the posts through a mix of layoffs and attrition because of a slower ramp-up to “provide our factories and supply chain partners additional time to achieve stability”, said a message to employees from Boeing commercial chief Stephanie Pope.

stories.title: Economic relief is on the way, Democrats say. But what, how and when?
